description:
The pages Pagefully suggests the app should have and does not: each with a name, a kind, what the page would say, the searches it is for and the reason. These are the suggestions the product already holds (such as a use the app's reviewers raise, or a competitor it follows). Reading them asks nothing of a model and costs nothing.
Call it when the person asks what to make next, or after get_results. To take one up, pass its "add" object to update_plan as an item of add, then call generate_pages. Offer them to the person and let them choose: never add one unasked.
Pagefully does not yet propose a fix for a page that trails the default page. For that, read get_results and the playbook (pagefully://playbook), and suggest edits to the first two screenshots for the person to decide.

app_id.description: The app's id in Pagefully (a UUID), as analyze_app returned it in app.id.

locale.description: An App Store language, such as en-US. Leave it out for the app's own language.
